verified.note: Record row (best variational bound; ED holds the instance record, 0.00034 below). 4 x 4 torus, 5 + 5, U = 2.15 (as printed), N~ = 10 and alpha = 64 (main Fig. 3 caption B: 'n = 5/8 average site occupancy (first closed shell) and N~ = 10. The rows of the hidden submatrix are given by single-hidden-layer neural networks with α = 64'). Projection: 'Projections to different symmetry subspaces are applied to the converged trial state: rotation of π/2 (C4), translations of momentum K = 0 and the intersection of both subspaces' (SI Sec. 8 B); the stored row is the intersection, as the method string says. A projected state's energy is at least its sector's minimum and so still an upper bound on the ground state: variational is right. Stored sigma equals the printed bar. No duplicate.
